verdict.rationale: Netlify's docs claim automatic DDoS protection, and the security page mentions Netlify Advanced Security, but no web application firewall is explicitly documented as applied to every request. Community reports describe a static site that was DDoS'd and billed $104k, with commenters calling it a known issue, which concretely contradicts the claim that default DDoS protection absorbs attack traffic. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented default WAF on all requests, evidence that DDoS protection blocks attack traffic rather than serving and billing it, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can have DDoS protection and a web application firewall applied to every request by default

citations.quote: Secure your project at any scale—whether you need the security of a banking site with Netlify Advanced Security
